title: What is the best way to architect an agent that you can train and control that is an NPC video game character in a game…
summary: The main design decision is to split the NPC into two loops that run at different speeds. A language-model agent takes somewhere between 300 ms and several seconds to decide anything. Unreal runs at 60 frames per second. So the AURA agent should never drive the NPC's body frame by frame. It acts as the NPC's mind: it picks goals and dialogue and calls high-level actions.
